paper.title: Mindfulness training reduces exam anxiety in undergraduates

paper_text:
Mindfulness training reduces exam anxiety in undergraduates
Smith, J.  J. Fake Psychology, 2021

Abstract
Eight weeks of mindfulness training reduced self-reported exam anxiety in 120 undergraduates.

Retraction: Mindfulness training improves sleep quality in nurses
